title: Dragon Ball Z Super Butouden 3
description: Dragon Ball Z: Super Butōden 3 (ドラゴンボールZ 超武闘伝３ Doragon Bōru Zetto Sūpā Butōden Surī, lit. Dragon Ball Z: Super Fighting Story 3), called Dragon Ball Z: Ultime Menacein French and Dragon Ball Z: Chomutujeon in Korea, is a fighting game released for Super Nintendo on September 29, 1994, in Japan and on January 25, 1995 in France and Spain. It is the third installment in the Butōden series.
